_definition: for one (memory, task), the WITHOUT arm carries no memory and is therefore the same question under every representation. Disagreement is execution/scoring nondeterminism, not an effect. This is NOT F_exec (paired re-execution of the SAME prompt within one run) and NOT F_empty (spread of the WITHOUT arm across memories). It is its own construction, reported so the three benchmarks are compared on one definition.

longmemeval_v2.note: joined on (memory_unit_locator, future_task_id). condition_id must NOT be in the key: it embeds the representation name, which forces an empty join.

swebench_verified.note: NOT MEASURABLE and not zero: the runner issues the WITHOUT call ONCE per cell and reuses it across representations by design, so the term cancels exactly in every paired contrast. A 0 here would be an artefact of the design, not a measurement, and must never be plotted or quoted as a floor.
